generation.explanation: Each ball hits 8 rows of pegs and bounces left or right with probability 1/2 at each one. Its final bin is the number of right bounces, which follows Binomial(8, 1/2). As balls pile up, the bars take the bell shape and approach the yellow theoretical dots. Use the button to drop more balls.
